absorptionBoosters: Glucose with sodium in ORS (helps gut absorption)
warnings: Sodium is tracked as a limit, not a target to reach; the default ceiling is 2,000 mg (about 5 g salt) a day.
good_source_dishes lists the lower-sodium dish picks, not sodium-rich dishes.
Do not use IFCT 'Prawns, big' (S008, 849 mg/100 g): suspect outlier; use about 188 mg/100 g (Q007).
Rock salt, black salt and pink salt are not low-sodium.
Potassium-enriched salt substitutes are not for kidney disease, pregnancy or users of ACE inhibitors, ARBs or potassium-sparing diuretics unless a doctor agrees.
Users with kidney, heart or liver disease, pregnancy, or on diuretics: show only the general range plus 'Follow your doctor's advice'; never push higher or lower salt or water.
Very low blood sodium signs (confusion, seizure, repeated vomiting): see a doctor now.

conditionAdjustments.change: Same 2,000 mg ceiling; optional 1,500 mg stretch goal only with doctor's agreement
